validation_environment: Local headless Chromium against isolated synthetic demo API
scope: Observed browser behavior only. No iOS/Android device, carrier, real vendor settlement/delivery, native-listener quality or production capacity qualification.
checks: Before consent, the exact server notice distinguishes transient raw audio from encrypted recovery text, deletion requests and scheduled retention
Desktop, 390px and 320px disclosures have no accessibility findings or horizontal overflow; consent starts unchecked
Explicit consent creates a real session with recording and training disabled and does not request the microphone
The same retention notice remains keyboard accessible during the conversation without blocking typed input
The session ends cleanly, with no microphone access or browser errors

audits.label: Active conversation privacy disclosure expanded by keyboard at 320px

qualification: This verifies disclosure, explicit consent payload and UI behavior. It does not certify the separate retention worker, deletion completion or legal policy.
